title: IBAN validation whose steps need no narration
task: Implement `Valid(iban string) bool` in package `iban` using the mod-97 check: strip spaces, uppercase, move the first four characters to the end, replace each letter with its number (A=10 through Z=35), and check that the resulting number modulo 97 equals 1, computing the modulus incrementally over the digits so it fits in an int. I want each of those steps to be obvious to a reader without a running narration. Test `GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32` as valid and a one-digit corruption of it as invalid.
